card.name: The word to after fetal harm when administered
card.fires_on: The small word "to" (sometimes "in") right after "administered", "harm" or "extends" in warnings about pregnancy, fetal harm or nursing infants. It points ahead to the person affected, such as a pregnant woman.

modes.label: Administered to a pregnant woman
modes.description: "to" after "administered" in fetal harm statements, before "a pregnant woman".
modes.example: AREL may cause fetal harm when administered<< to>> a pregnant woman.

modes.label: Harm to / reactions in a group
modes.description: "to" or "in" after "harm" or "adverse reactions", before fetus or nursing infants.
